title: Image::resize when using Image.Interpolation.INTERPOLATE_CUBIC causes artifacts
body:
### Tested versions

4.3, 4.4

### System information

N/A

### Issue description

When resizing an image using `INTERPOLATE_CUBIC` it causes artifacts lines at the top and left of the image.
Related: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/9126

### Steps to reproduce

Run the EditorScript in MRP and compare output, or run this script with your own images in your own project.
```gdscript
@tool
extends EditorScript

const TEXTURE = preload("res://Original.png")

func _run() -> void:
	_perform_operation("LANCZOS", Image.Interpolation.INTERPOLATE_LANCZOS)
	_perform_operation("CUBIC", Image.Interpolation.INTERPOLATE_CUBIC)
	#_perform_operation("NEAREST", Image.Interpolation.INTERPOLATE_NEAREST)
	#_perform_operation("TRILINEAR", Image.Interpolation.INTERPOLATE_TRILINEAR)

func _perform_operation(file_name: String, interpolation: Image.Interpolation, to_size := Vector2i(512,512)) -> void:
	var image := TEXTURE.get_image().duplicate() as Image #  duplicated so that we dont modify the stored image in PortableCompressedTexture2D 

	if image.get_size() == to_size:
		printerr("Cannot reproduce issue if images are same size.")
	image.resize(to_size.x, to_size.y, interpolation)
	image.save_png("res://" + file_name + ".png")
```
